result:
All unit tests pass (550), integration errors pre-existing missing `typer` dep, unrelated.

Two bugs found and fixed in `src/verityai/context/prune.py`:

1. **`dropped_critical` never populated.** Line 108 unconditionally reset to `[]` even inside the `not budget_met` branch — the "record what didn't fit" logic never existed. Fixed: now lists ids of protected items still present when over budget.

2. **Tiebreak sorted newest-first, docstring says oldest-first.** `-i.original_index` ascending puts largest index (newest) first in candidate list → dropped first. Flipped to `i.original_index` so oldest (smallest index) sorts first and gets dropped first, matching docstring/comment.

Added 3 regression tests to `tests/unit/test_prune.py`: dropped_critical populated on failure, stays empty on success, tiebreak drops oldest first. All pass.
